objective: Keep a new systemic or critical design task moving through drafting and review until its work order is approved.

observed_failure.summary: A session with no current autopilot objective and no progress reminder can become idle during design review and iteration.

existing_capabilities: design-doc owns scope, architecture, challenge, and design review until the work order is approved
unattended-run already owns native autopilot objective delivery through the session-control SDK
unattended-run already owns schedule creation, reconciliation, and shutdown
manage_schedule can create, list, and stop recurring prompts
the normal unattended-run lifecycle uses one hourly progress reminder and one four-hour charter check after a durable work order exists

constraints.constraint: Do not start implementation before design-doc completes.
Do not overwrite an unrelated active objective or duplicate a compatible reminder.
constraints.provenance: existing objective replacement and schedule reconciliation rules
constraints.protects: the current task and bounded schedule ownership

constraints.constraint: Do not require a complete implementation charter before the design work order exists.
constraints.provenance: the reported gap occurs before design approval

constraints.constraint: Do not launch duplicate challenge or review work when an owner is already active.
constraints.provenance: development-loop ownership rules and immutable first outcomes

success: the agent receives a persistent design-phase objective at design kickoff
a short reminder advances the next ready design or review action
the reminder stops when design approval, abandonment, or handoff occurs
normal unattended-run state replaces the temporary state only when implementation is already authorized
non_goals: a new scheduler, service, extension, or objective transport
full unattended-run charter governance before a work order exists
automatic replacement of an unrelated active objective
repeated user prompts while a genuine user-only decision is pending
